findings.effect: The sender's consumer profile is looked up but only used to skip the invitation when it is missing. This makes the professional invitation depend on Ricardo also having an unrelated consumer profile.

The journey is picked by template key from only the first page of 100 journeys. If another home-seller-v1 journey is seeded, or the list passes 100 journeys, the invitation will silently go to the wrong journey or be skipped.
